contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of all three .sdata2 claims: independently read entry bodies establish literal uses but cannot establish compiled pool size, representation, placement, or load attribution. No compiled evidence was supplied.

Accept supersession of the unconditional no-underflow explanation. Nonzero counters decrement without a negative-value clamp; ownership-loss clearing occurs in the else branch and cannot take the absent-item exit in that invocation.
